recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients: 1 Smoked Mackerel fillet, 1 ripe Avocado, 1 tbsp Lemon juice, Black pepper, fresh Dill.
recipes.instructions: 1. Flake the mackerel into a bowl. 2. Add avocado and mash with a fork. 3. Stir in lemon juice and pepper. 4. Serve on keto bread or cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
recipes.ingredients: 30g Ground Flaxseed, 20g Chopped Walnuts, 100ml Almond Milk, 1/2 tsp Cinnamon, 5g Erythritol.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix flaxseed and almond milk in a small pot. 2. Heat gently until thickened. 3. Stir in cinnamon and erythritol. 4. Top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
recipes.ingredients: 200g Firm Tofu, 100g Fresh Spinach, 1/2 tsp Turmeric, 1 tsp Nutritional Yeast, 1 tbsp Olive Oil.
recipes.instructions: 1. Crumble tofu into a pan with olive oil. 2. Add turmeric and yeast. 3. Sauté for 5 mins, then fold in spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Chia & Berry Skyr Bowl
recipes.ingredients: 150g Skyr (Plain), 15g Chia Seeds, 50g Frozen Raspberries, 10g Sliced Almonds.
recipes.instructions: 1. Stir chia seeds into the skyr. 2. Let sit for 10 mins. 3. Top with raspberries and almonds.

recipes.title: Almond Savory Pancakes
recipes.ingredients: 100g Almond Flour, 2 Large Eggs, 50ml Almond Milk, 1/2 tsp Baking Powder, Salt, Pepper.
recipes.instructions: 1. Whisk all ingredients into a smooth batter. 2. Pour small circles into a greased pan. 3. Fry until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Zucchini Walnut Muffins
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 100g Grated Zucchini (Squeezed Dry), 2 Eggs, 30g Walnuts, 1 tsp Cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix dry ingredients. 2. Stir in eggs and zucchini. 3. Fold in walnuts. 4. Bake at 180°C for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Roll-ups
recipes.ingredients: 100g Smoked Salmon, 50g Low Fat Cream Cheese, Fresh Chives, Cucumber Strips.
recipes.instructions: 1. Spread cream cheese on salmon slices. 2. Place cucumber in center and roll. 3. Garnish with chives.

recipes.title: Oats Yogurt Fruit Bowl
recipes.ingredients: 40g Rolled Oats, 200g Greek Yogurt (0% Fat), 100g Mixed Berries, 1 tsp Honey.
recipes.instructions: 1. Layer oats and yogurt in a jar/bowl. 2. Top with berries and honey. 3. Let soak for 30 mins or overnight.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
recipes.ingredients: 4 Eggs, 2 Slices Whole Grain Toast, 10ml Milk, 5g Butter, Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Whisk eggs with milk. 2. Scramble in butter over medium heat. 3. Serve on toasted bread.

recipes.title: Yogurt Oats Bowl
recipes.ingredients: 200g Greek Yogurt, 30g Oats, 1 tbsp Chia Seeds, 5g Walnuts.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix oats and chia into yogurt. 2. Let sit for 15 mins. 3. Top with walnuts before serving.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Baked Cod
recipes.ingredients: 2 Cod Fillets, 30g Almond Flour, 1 tsp Dried Parsley, 1 tsp Lemon Zest, 1 tbsp Olive Oil.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix almond flour, herbs, and zest. 2. Press onto cod fillets. 3. Drizzle with oil and bake at 200°C for 12-15 mins.

recipes.title: Turkey & Zucchini Stir-fry
recipes.ingredients: 300g Turkey Breast, 1 Large Zucchini (Spiralized), 1 Bell Pepper, 1 tbsp Soy Sauce, 1 tsp Ginger.
recipes.instructions: 1. Sauté turkey strips until cooked. 2. Add pepper and zucchini noodles. 3. Toss with soy sauce and ginger for 3 mins.

recipes.title: Walnut-Crusted Tofu Steaks
recipes.ingredients: 250g Extra Firm Tofu, 50g Crushed Walnuts, 1 tbsp Dijon Mustard, 1 tbsp Olive Oil.
recipes.instructions: 1. Slice tofu into steaks and pat dry. 2. Brush with mustard and press into walnuts. 3. Pan-sear until walnuts are toasted.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chicken Salad
recipes.ingredients: 200g Cooked Chicken Breast, 50g Feta, 10 Kalamata Olives, 1 Cucumber, Lemon-Olive Oil Dressing.
recipes.instructions: 1. Chop chicken and vegetables. 2. Toss with olives and crumbled feta. 3. Drizzle with dressing.

recipes.title: Mushroom Cauliflower Risotto
recipes.ingredients: 400g Cauliflower Rice, 150g Mushrooms, 1 Shallot, 30g Parmesan, 50ml Veg Stock.
recipes.instructions: 1. Sauté shallots and mushrooms. 2. Add cauliflower rice and stock. 3. Cook until liquid is gone. 4. Stir in parmesan.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Baked Herring
recipes.ingredients: 2 Whole Herring (Cleaned), 2 Garlic Cloves, 1 Lemon (Sliced), 1 tbsp Olive Oil.
recipes.instructions: 1. Stuff herring with garlic and lemon slices. 2. Drizzle with oil. 3. Bake at 190°C for 15-20 mins.

recipes.title: Lean Beef & Broccoli Stir-fry
recipes.ingredients: 250g Lean Beef Strips, 200g Broccoli Florets, 1 tbsp Sesame Oil, 1 tbsp Soy Sauce.
recipes.instructions: 1. Sear beef in sesame oil. 2. Add broccoli and a splash of water. 3. Cover and steam for 3 mins. 4. Season with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Tuna Potato Bowl
recipes.ingredients: 1 Can Tuna in Brine, 200g Boiled New Potatoes, 50g Green Beans, 1 Hard Boiled Egg.
recipes.instructions: 1. Halve potatoes and mix with tuna. 2. Add steamed beans and sliced egg. 3. Season with salt and vinegar.

recipes.title: Spiced Bean Bowl
recipes.ingredients: 1 Can Mixed Beans, 100g Spinach, 1/2 Onion, 1 tsp Cumin, 1 tsp Chili Powder.
recipes.instructions: 1. Sauté onion until soft. 2. Add rinsed beans and spices. 3. Stir in spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Tofu Lentil Bolognese
recipes.ingredients: 200g Lentils (Cooked), 200g Firm Tofu (Crumbled), 400g Chopped Tomatoes, 1 Carrot, 1 Celery.
recipes.instructions: 1. Sauté carrot and celery. 2. Add tofu and cook until browned. 3. Add lentils and tomatoes. 4. Simmer for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Turkey Burgers
recipes.ingredients: 500g Ground Turkey, 1 Egg, 1 tsp Garlic Powder, 1 tsp Onion Powder, Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. 2. Form into 4 patties. 3. Grill or pan-fry for 6 mins per side.

recipes.title: Med. Chicken Bake
recipes.ingredients: 2 Chicken Breasts, 1 Bell Pepper, 1 Red Onion, 10 Cherry Tomatoes, 1 tbsp Oregano.
recipes.instructions: 1. Chop veg into chunks. 2. Place chicken and veg on a tray. 3. Season and bake at 200°C for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Veggie Burger
recipes.ingredients: 1 Can Chickpeas, 1 tsp Cumin, 1 tsp Coriander, 50g Breadcrumbs, 1 Egg.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mash chickpeas. 2. Mix with spices, egg, and breadcrumbs. 3. Form into patties and fry until crisp.

recipes.title: Turkey Burger Wrap
recipes.ingredients: 1 Turkey Burger Patty, 2 Large Lettuce Leaves, 1 Slice Tomato, 1 tbsp Mustard.
recipes.instructions: 1. Use lettuce leaves as a bun. 2. Place patty inside. 3. Top with tomato and mustard.

recipes.title: Veggie Burger Wrap
recipes.ingredients: 1 Veggie Patty, 2 Lettuce Leaves, 1 tbsp Hummus.
recipes.instructions: 1. Place patty on lettuce. 2. Spread hummus on top. 3. Wrap and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom & Spinach Pasta
recipes.ingredients: 100g Whole Wheat Pasta (Dry), 150g Mushrooms, 100g Spinach, 1 Garlic Clove.
recipes.instructions: 1. Boil pasta. 2. Sauté mushrooms and garlic. 3. Toss pasta and spinach into the pan. 4. Mix until spinach wilts.

recipes.title: Fillet Steak & Potatoes
recipes.ingredients: 150g Beef Fillet, 150g Boiled Potatoes, Steamed Asparagus, 1 tsp Olive Oil.
recipes.instructions: 1. Pan-sear steak to desired doneness. 2. Serve with potatoes and asparagus.

recipes.title: Fillet Steak & Mushrooms
recipes.ingredients: 150g Beef Fillet, 200g Sliced Mushrooms, 1 tbsp Butter, Garlic.
recipes.instructions: 1. Fry mushrooms in butter and garlic. 2. Sear steak separately. 3. Serve steak topped with mushrooms.

recipes.title: Chicken & Broccoli Pasta
recipes.ingredients: 150g Cooked Chicken, 100g Pasta (Dry), 200g Broccoli, 1 tbsp Pesto.
recipes.instructions: 1. Cook pasta and broccoli together. 2. Drain and toss with chicken and pesto.

recipes.title: Golden Flax Seed Bread
recipes.ingredients: 200g Ground Flaxseed, 5 Eggs, 100ml Water, 1 tsp Baking Powder, Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix all ingredients. 2. Pour into a loaf tin. 3. Bake at 180°C for 45 mins.

recipes.title: Rosemary Olive Oil Focaccia
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 2 Eggs, 50ml Olive Oil, Fresh Rosemary, Sea Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix flour, eggs, and half the oil. 2. Spread on a tray. 3. Dimple with fingers, add remaining oil and rosemary. 4. Bake for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Savory Walnut Zucchini Loaf
recipes.ingredients: 200g Almond Flour, 200g Zucchini, 3 Eggs, 50g Walnuts.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix dry ingredients. 2. Add eggs and squeezed zucchini. 3. Fold in walnuts. 4. Bake at 170°C for 50 mins.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Seeded Crackers
recipes.ingredients: 50g Chia Seeds, 50g Pumpkin Seeds, 50g Sunflower Seeds, 100ml Water.
recipes.instructions: 1. Soak seeds in water for 15 mins until gelled. 2. Spread thinly on parchment paper. 3. Bake at 150°C for 1 hour until crisp.

recipes.title: Spinach & Almond Muffins
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 100g Spinach (Blended), 2 Eggs, 1 tsp Baking Powder.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix blended spinach with eggs. 2. Stir in flour and baking powder. 3. Bake in muffin tins for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Almond Soft Tortilla Wraps
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 1 tsp Xanthan Gum, 1 Egg, Water as needed.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix into a dough. 2. Roll between parchment paper. 3. Dry fry in a pan for 1 min per side.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Seed Flatbread
recipes.ingredients: 100g Ground Pumpkin Seeds, 2 Eggs, Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix seeds and eggs. 2. Spread on a tray. 3. Bake at 180°C for 12 mins.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buns
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 30g Psyllium Husk, 3 Egg Whites, 1 cup Boiling Water.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix dry. 2. Add egg whites and boiling water. 3. Form buns and bake for 50 mins.

recipes.title: Bread Rolls
recipes.ingredients: 100g Almond Flour, 2 Eggs, 10g Baking Powder.
recipes.instructions: 1. Whisk eggs. 2. Stir in flour. 3. Shape and bake for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Sandwich Bread
recipes.ingredients: 500g Whole Wheat Flour, 7g Yeast, 300ml Warm Water, Salt.
recipes.instructions: 1. Knead ingredients into a dough. 2. Let rise for 1 hour. 3. Bake in loaf tin for 35 mins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies (Erythritol)
recipes.ingredients: 150g Dark Chocolate, 100g Butter, 100g Erythritol, 50g Almond Flour.
recipes.instructions: 1. Melt chocolate and butter. 2. Stir in erythritol and flour. 3. Bake at 180°C for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Avocado Chocolate Mousse
recipes.ingredients: 1 Avocado, 20g Cocoa Powder, 20ml Maple Syrup (or Sugar Free Syrup).
recipes.instructions: 1. Blend all ingredients until perfectly smooth. 2. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Mug Cake
recipes.ingredients: 30g Almond Flour, 1 Egg, 10g Raspberries, 1 tsp Erythritol.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix in a mug. 2. Microwave for 90 seconds. 3. Let cool for 1 min.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Walnut Clusters
recipes.ingredients: 100g Dark Chocolate (90%), 50g Walnuts.
recipes.instructions: 1. Melt chocolate. 2. Toss in walnuts. 3. Spoon onto paper and let set in fridge.

recipes.title: Vanilla Berry Chia Pudding
recipes.ingredients: 30g Chia Seeds, 200ml Almond Milk, Vanilla Extract, 20g Berries.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix chia and milk. 2. Shake and chill for 4 hours. 3. Top with berries.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.ingredients: 150g Almond Flour, 1 tsp Poppy Seeds, Lemon Juice, 2 Eggs.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix ingredients. 2. Pour into tins. 3. Bake for 20 mins at 180°C.

recipes.title: Almond & Berry Crumble
recipes.ingredients: 100g Mixed Berries, 30g Almond Flour, 10g Sliced Almonds, 1 tsp Butter.
recipes.instructions: 1. Place berries in ramekins. 2. Rub flour and butter. 3. Top berries and bake for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Cocoa-Walnut Truffles
recipes.ingredients: 50g Dates, 20g Walnuts, 10g Cocoa Powder.
recipes.instructions: 1. Process all in a blender. 2. Roll into balls. 3. Coat in cocoa powder.

recipes.title: Protein Brownies
recipes.ingredients: 100g Protein Powder, 20g Cocoa, 1 Egg, 50ml Milk.
recipes.instructions: 1. Stir into a paste. 2. Bake at 160°C for 12 mins.

recipes.title: Bread pudding
recipes.ingredients: 150g Stale Bread, 2 Eggs, 200ml Milk, Raisins.
recipes.instructions: 1. Soak bread in milk. 2. Whisk in eggs and raisins. 3. Bake for 30 mins.

recipes.title: Yogurt Cheesecake
recipes.ingredients: 500g Greek Yogurt, 2 Eggs, 30g Cornstarch, Sweetener.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix and pour into tin. 2. Bake at 150°C for 40 mins. 3. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Choc Cake
recipes.ingredients: 2 Bananas, 100g Oats, 20g Choc Chips.
recipes.instructions: 1. Mash bananas. 2. Stir in oats and chips. 3. Bake for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Banana Cocoa Cake
recipes.ingredients: 2 Bananas, 20g Cocoa, 2 Eggs.
recipes.instructions: 1. Blend. 2. Bake for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bean Cake
recipes.ingredients: 1 Can Black Beans, 3 Eggs, 30g Cocoa.
recipes.instructions: 1. Rinse and blend beans with eggs and cocoa. 2. Bake for 30 mins.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
recipes.ingredients: 2 Apples, 100g Whole Wheat Flour, 1 Egg, Cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: 1. Chop apples. 2. Mix with rest. 3. Bake for 35 mins.
